## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Das lässt mich kalt.** — [dahs lehst mish kahlt] — *That leaves me cold. (I don't care about it.)*
2. **Ich bin in meinem Element.** — [ish bin in MY-nem eh-leh-MENT] — *I'm in my element.*
3. **Es liegt mir am Herzen.** — [ess leekt meer ahm HAIR-tsen] — *It's close to my heart.*
